inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn 2D Japanese anime frame. Preserve ink outlines, hard-edged cel shading, flat matte skin, broad hair locks and painted gothic backgrounds throughout. Preserve identities, clothing, number of characters and established scenery. Intentional animation with anticipation, force, follow-through and settle; no loop, CGI, extra limbs, character morphing, unrelated cut, orbit or unmotivated zoom. Kimi rises from the low crouch, plants both feet and takes ONE short backward step toward Claude behind her while still facing the attackers. She brings her hands and blades close to her torso and begins a compact protective gesture. Her weight settles over the rear foot, her hem follows naturally. A low indigo arc begins along the floor around the altar perimeter, pushing the nearest burning logs outward. No running toward the camera, no disappearance, no full shield yet. Fixed camera.
